rules.title: San Diego Residential Tenant Protection Ordinance
rules.requirement: Landlords must have at-fault or no-fault just cause to terminate a covered tenancy, state the cause in the termination notice, and pay relocation assistance for no-fault terminations. Buyout offers require written disclosures, and buyout agreements must meet strict form requirements or are void.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance of 2 months' rent (3 months if tenant is senior 62+ or disabled) for no-fault terminations
rules.penalty: Failure to comply with the right-of-offer requirement renders the termination notice void (except withdrawal from rental market). Noncompliant buyout agreements are void.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7
rules.status_basis: The Ordinance goes into effect June 24, 2023.

requires.name: tenancy_definition
requires.text: Applies only to a Tenancy: the lawful right to continuously use/occupy a residential rental property for more than 30 days; does not include a fixed term lease of three months or less.

exempt_if.name: transient_hotel
exempt_if.text: A tenant of a transient and tourist hotel

exempt_if.name: short_term_occupancy
exempt_if.text: Any residential occupancy for a period of 30 consecutive days or less, e.g., AirBNB or VRBO

exempt_if.name: deed_restricted_affordable
exempt_if.text: Housing restricted by deed, regulatory restriction or other recorded document as affordable housing for very low, low, or moderate income households

exempt_if.name: subsidized_affordable
exempt_if.text: Housing subject to an agreement providing housing subsidies for affordable housing; does not apply to a tenant with a Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher

exempt_if.name: mobilehome_MRL
exempt_if.text: Mobilehomes subject to the Mobilehome Residency Law

exempt_if.name: institutional_housing
exempt_if.text: Housing in nonprofit hospital, religious facility, extended care facility, licensed residential care facility for the elderly, or non-profit transitional housing

exempt_if.name: dormitory
exempt_if.text: Dormitories owned and operated by an institution of higher education

exempt_if.name: shared_facilities_with_owner
exempt_if.text: Tenant shares the bathroom or kitchen with the Owner who maintains their principal residence at the unit

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied_single_family
exempt_if.text: Single-family owner-occupied residence where the owner rents no more than two units or bedrooms
Property with two dwelling units in a single structure where the Owner occupies one as principal residence (neither is an ADU/JADU)

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied_duplex
exempt_if.text: Owner occupies one unit as principal place of residence at start of tenancy and continues in occupancy

exempt_if.name: alienable_unit_non_corporate_owner
exempt_if.text: Unit alienable separate from title to any other unit, where the landlord is not a REIT, corporation, LLC with a corporate member, or mobilehome park management, and tenants were given written notice of exemption
Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the dwelling is a mobilehome

coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies of more than 30 days in San Diego, including rented dwellings in mobilehome parks.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts transient/short-term stays, deed-restricted or subsidized affordable housing, institutional housing, dormitories, certain owner-occupied properties, certain non-corporate-owned separately alienable units with notice, and housing with a certificate of occupancy issued within the previous 15 years.

rules.quoted_span: The purpose of the Ordinance is to require Just Cause for termination of residential tenancies consistent with California Civil Code section 1946.2, to limit the reasons for termination of a residential tenancy, to require greater tenant relocation assistance in specified circumstances and to provide additional tenant protections.
